description: Line starts of a served browser script for the x_fallow_line_starts source map field. Each case gives the served script text and the expected starts: the offset, in UTF-16 code units, of column 0 of each generated line, or null when the layout is unknown and the field must be left out. Any implementation of these rules must give the same result for every case.

cases.name: empty script
one line without a line break
cases.served: export{t};

cases.name: plain lines
line break at the end
CRLF line ends count the carriage return
cases.served:
a
bc
d

cases.name: byte order mark is not counted
two-byte UTF-8 character is one UTF-16 unit
cases.served:
é
x
